name: I, Robot 2
source:
The Robot War rages on, and so does the war in Del Spooner’s heart. Join Del on a journey of maturation and self-discovery, with some gay robots along the way.

[From [url=https://stamblerrambler.itch.io/i-robot-2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
机器人战争仍在激烈进行，戴尔·斯普纳内心的战争也未曾平息。与戴尔一起踏上成长与自我探索之旅，途中还会遇见一些同性恋机器人。

[摘自[url=https://stamblerrambler.itch.io/i-robot-2]Itch.io[/url]]
